name: VYX AI
description: Interactive VYX AI control menu with live physics frame counter, P1/P2 jump input tracker, and recent input history.

frame-counter.name: Physics Frame Counter
frame-counter.description: Show the live physics-frame number during gameplay.

click-tracker.name: Jump Input Tracker
click-tracker.description: Count P1/P2 jump presses and show their frame numbers and spacing.

input-history.name: Recent Input History
input-history.description: Show the four most recent P1/P2 jump inputs in the gameplay HUD.
